name: Myles Lozano
headline: Mechanical and Aerospace engineering student with a minor in Electrical Engineering, builder, and problem solver
shortBio: Engineering student at Oklahoma State University passionate about designing innovative solutions and bringing ideas to life through hands-on development.
longBio:
I am a dual-major engineering student at Oklahoma State University studying Aerospace Engineering and Mechanical Engineering.

My experience spans product development, engineering design, prototyping, and early-stage system development through roles with Springfield Remanufacturing Company, the OSU New Product Development Center, and TriPoint Innovations LLC, which I cofounded.

At TriPoint Innovations, I lead product design efforts, guiding the development of early-stage hardware and system concepts from initial idea through prototyping and refinement. I am currently continuing my engineering experience through a Summer 2026 internship with GE Aerospace, where my work focuses on applied engineering, technical execution, and systems-level problem solving.
